scope.summary: Build the archetype seeding framework per Section 13.27 acceptance archetypes: the 8 operator acceptance archetypes seed as deterministic BRC- recipes (pure channel-value sets with stable ids), idempotently re-seedable, each carrying the EXACT operator wording of its target build as metadata (OBR implications 5 — each archetype becomes a seeded test body + validation row).
acceptance_criteria: Seeding creates BRC- rows with stable ids BRC-ARCH-A through BRC-ARCH-H; each recipe is a pure channel-value set (no mesh payload) that deterministically reconstructs its BodySpec (hash-stable across seeds and machines).
Re-seeding is idempotent: existing rows are verified, not duplicated or clobbered; a drifted row (edited archetype) fails the seed check with a typed diff rather than silent overwrite.
Each recipe's metadata records the exact operator wording of the archetype target (verbatim from the acceptance archetype list) so validators compare against the stated intent, not a paraphrase.
The framework exposes an iterator the QA matrices (MT-641..645) consume, so adding a future archetype extends every matrix automatically.
scope.risk_if_missed: The acceptance archetypes exist only as prose — every QA matrix improvises its own test bodies, results are irreproducible across machines, and the operator's canonical acceptance cases are never actually pinned.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > BodyKit quality assurance and references

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Run the accepted source assets, anatomy, genital, creator-tool, DCC, visual, and performance corpora with pinned metrics and exact artifact inspection.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
